plan.summary: BRO-6493: page-validated opening and preview dates for closed off-Broadway same-date rows; source confirmations retain legitimate same-day openings (part 3 of 3)
steps: BRO-6493: Producer advertises world premiere April 7 to 12, 2026 only; TDF explicitly confirms April 7 opening. Source: https://experiences.aks-tickets.com/THE-LISTENING-HOME/ Corroboration: https://www.tdf.org/shows/23116/the-listening/

BRO-6493: Venue advertises the October 2, 2026 touring comedy performance; TheaterMania confirms October 2 opening and October 3 closing. Source: https://tribecapac.org/event/brian-hensons-puppet-up/ Corroboration: https://www.theatermania.com/shows/new-york-city-theater/off-broadway/puppet-up_1850321/

BRO-6493: Venue dates touring musical October 17 to 25, 2026, with author signing after first performance; TDF confirms October 17 opening. Source: https://www.newvictory.org/events/2627-live-performance-rosie-revere-ada-twist-and-iggy-peck Corroboration: https://www.tdf.org/shows/23576/rosie-revere-ada-twist-and-iggy-peck-the-questioneers/

BRO-6493: New York premiere of touring breakdance show starts March 7, 2026; TheaterMania explicitly confirms March 7 opening. Source: https://www.broadwayworld.com/off-broadway/article/ILL-Abilities-Breakdancing-Troupe-to-Perform-at-New-Victory-Theater-20260210 Corroboration: https://www.theatermania.com/shows/new-york-city-theater/no-excuses-no-limits_1822672/

BRO-6493: Contemporary eyewitness explicitly dates opening March 20, 2026; Met's indexed dated program labels that performance the season premiere. Source: https://parterre.com/2026/04/07/cavalcade-of-stars/ Corroboration: https://www.metopera.org/globalassets/season/2025-26/la-traviata/programs/032026-traviata.pdf

BRO-6493: Indexed production page explicitly lists both first preview and opening March 18, 2026; contemporaneous article confirms the City Center Encores run. Source: https://playbill.com/production/the-wild-party-off-broadway-new-york-city-center-2026 Corroboration: https://playbill.com/article/jasmine-amy-rogers-adrienne-warren-more-star-in-encores-the-wild-party-beginning-march-18
